name: Can I upgrade my existing cabinet hardware during a minor refresh, or is it better for a full renovation?

mainEntity.name: Can I upgrade my existing cabinet hardware during a minor refresh, or is it better for a full renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading existing cabinet hardware can provide a noticeable aesthetic refresh and improved functionality, even without a full renovation. However, for a truly integrated and high-value transformation, we recommend considering hardware upgrades as part of a more substantial renovation, such as a luxury kitchen or spa-inspired bathroom remodel. This allows for a holistic design approach where hardware selections perfectly align with new cabinetry, countertops, and overall room aesthetics. AKN Design Group specializes in customized renovations, ensuring that every detail, including hardware, contributes to enhancing functionality, beauty, and long-term value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hardware upgrades can refresh a space, but for an integrated, high-value transformation, it's best done as part of a substantial renovation.
